mapper.select: SELECT icam20_isin AS isin , icam20_item_nm AS item_name FROM icam20_price WHERE icam20_std_date = CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND icam20_item_type = #{itemType} AND UPPER(CONCAT(icam20_item_cd, icam20_item_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY icam20_item_cd LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM icam20_price WHERE icam20_std_date = CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND icam20_item_type = #{itemType} AND UPPER(CONCAT(icam20_item_cd, icam20_item_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
SELECT TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN CAST(#{date} AS date) >= f_today() THEN f_get_biz_date2(0, f_today(), '-1', 'true') ELSE CAST(#{date} AS date) END, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
